units.title: Remain inside the vehicle unless the officer directs you to get out.

units.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility

units.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility

units.title: Tell the officer at the first contact if there is a weapon in the vehicle.
units.domain: Health, police stops and financial responsibility

units.title: Wait for directions before reaching for a license or vehicle paperwork.
